changes.feed_artifact_path: append_incident_feed requires the deterministic path derived from the incident timestamp and full incident identity digest
changes.artifact_custody: explicit owner-safe read with byte bound, no-follow and stable-file checks on POSIX; explicit handle-safe bounded read on Windows
changes.artifact_content: the referenced artifact bytes must exactly equal the canonical serialization of the incident payload before a feed row can be published
changes.normal_owner_path: write_incident retains bounded feed preflight, immutable artifact publication, then atomic feed publication on POSIX
changes.failure: missing, substituted, or mismatched artifact references fail before feed mutation

limitations: Artifact and pressure feed remain local owner-generated records without an authenticated independent incident issuer.
The pressure feed remains mutable narrative even though each newly appended row is now bound to the exact artifact bytes and canonical path.
No attack, independent corroboration, defensive consequence, or production behavior is established.
